operator_attention.item: Scaffold 4a→4b migration (Tranche A) is mechanical but the regression net is the 74 existing tests + manual real-tenant verify. Allow ~1 day for the migration; existing iframe routes (/, /full-page) MUST keep working.
30-second polling cap (NFR-5) is a guess at Stripe's 95th-percentile webhook delivery. If real-tenant smoke shows >30s lag in test mode, bump to 60s. Configurable via env var.

OA-001-6: Operator decides Stripe Tax Dashboard toggle (enable/disable) for test mode. Code ships with automatic_tax enabled; runtime error if disabled in dashboard. Defer until Tranche C verification or earlier.
OA-001-7: Install Stripe CLI for local webhook listen (`stripe listen --forward-to localhost:3000/api/webhooks/stripe`). Required before Tranche D smoke.
OA-001-8: Create real webhook endpoint in Stripe Dashboard pointing at public Vercel/ngrok URL (`/api/webhooks/stripe`). Captures STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET. Required before Tranche D ship.

UI Designer (05) skipped per scope_dial.ui_variants=skip. PRD-001 introduces no new UI surfaces — the `PaywallCheckoutDialog` rewire (close → open Stripe Checkout tab) and the `/paywall-return` page are behavior changes inside already-designed surfaces. POC clickdummy from PRD-000 (poc-v1-prd000/) remains the visual source of truth for the dialog. No new POC needed.

Tranche B RED-test fixtures (T012/T013/T014/T016/T018/T020/T022–T025) are written against the Stripe API documentation shape (https://stripe.com/docs/api) BEFORE the T006 `.d.ts` capture lands. Per progressive-fixture-capture preference, the assumption is that fixture deltas (if any) get fixed inline when T006 captures the real `.d.ts` types post-install. Watch for: parameter renames, optional-vs-required mismatches, and discriminated-union event shapes. Fixture provenance note is added inline in § 9.3 of the task breakdown.

Webhook handler ((≤5s latency) is asserted as an ACCEPTANCE/performance test, not a deterministic RED unit test. The unit suite covers handler correctness (signature, idempotency, dispatch) but does not gate the latency NFR-3. Latency check happens at Tranche D operator gate with the real Stripe Dashboard webhook test. If handler hits >5s under live load, Stripe will retry → idempotency must hold (this IS unit-tested via T042 duplicate event.id scenario).
